findings.title: Missing cache re-check after acquiring write lock
findings.body: `GetWebAssets` checks `entryPointAssetsCache` under `RLock()`, releases the read lock, and then acquires `entryPointAssetsCacheMu.Lock()`, but does not re-check whether another goroutine populated `entryPointAssetsCache` while waiting for the write lock. When multiple concurrent requests arrive before the cache is initialized (and `cfg.Env != setting.Dev`), every waiting goroutine will redundantly open and parse `assets-manifest.json` under the exclusive lock instead of returning the newly cached result.
